name: The Simpsons
description: Display random quotes from The Simpsons.
project_description:
This module scrapes The Simpsons quotes from Wikiquote. The Simpsons is an animated TV series.

 Features 
 There is one feature - display random The Simpsons quotes in a block.

 Post-Installation 
 Go to /admin/structure/block and configure the block. If you want The Simpsons quotes to be translated to your website's language, just visit /admin/config/system/simpsons and tick the appropriate box.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module doesn't have any dependencies aside from Drupal core.
